narrative.intro: Stonex Financial obligated $91.7M in federal contract obligations in FY27 to date. Stonex Financial won 7 awards this fiscal year to date, with an average award size of $13.1M. Stonex Financial obligations are down 92.9% year over year. Fiscal-year trends show higher totals in prior years: FY22 totaled $1.7B, FY23 totaled $1.7B, FY24 totaled $703M, FY25 totaled $1.3B, and FY26 totaled $1.3B. Current-year totals are partial and reflect fiscal year to date activity, while the listed award figures for large awards and expiring contracts represent total contract values rather than current-year obligations. This profile points to a much smaller obligation stream in FY27 to date compared with the multihundred-million and billion-dollar years immediately before. Contractors and contracting officers looking at Stonex Financial should note the concentration of prior-year spending and the sharp decline in current-year obligations when assessing competition, supply capacity, or partnership opportunities in the federal market.
